selection: Same seven baseline raw-validation floors; .35accuracy+.65macroF1, student/EMA. No test during training.
method: Longer continuation of previously successful full-network recipe, same own baseline teacher on TRAIN ONLY, doubled conservative backbone LR, lower CE class weighting, no auxiliary/shortcut dropout/MixUp and no foreign teacher.
teacher_cache: Verified frozen baseline classifier evaluated on SHA-bound training-only feature cache. Validation and test excluded.
disclosure: Third exploratory recipe added after negative auxiliary/capacity/foreign-teacher validation outcomes; reused validation, not a fresh prospective benchmark.
test: At most one frozen candidate from the declared runs, strict all-metrics integration, no alternate test search.
